3652-5006-6495-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Ornithopter is starting in your graveyard.
3652-5006-6495-8170.description:
Cast Ornithopter by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Ornithopter spell. Then, activate Evereth by sacrificing Ornithopter, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
3652-5006-6495-8170.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

783-1432-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Ioreth of the Healing House doesn't have summoning sickness.
783-1432-2645-3430.description:
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, untapping Jungle Basin
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

2178-3817-6542-8095.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-3817-6542-8095.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

3197-5256-6012--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Reluctant Role Model triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Ioreth of the Healing House or Clever Conjurer

1432-2872-7786.description:
Activate Ioreth of the Healing House by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
If Ioreth of the Healing House has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Ioreth of the Healing House ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Ioreth of the Healing House.
If Clever Conjurer has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Ioreth of the Healing House.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to either Kelpie Guide or Clever Conjurer

2085-2872-7786.description:
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Clever Conjurer.
If Kelpie Guide has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
If Clever Conjurer has Hawkeye's Bow attached to it, Hawkeye's Bow triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Clever Conjurer ability, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7753-7864.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Ravenhill Flock triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

413-1116-1580-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Sek'Kuar and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Reassembling Skeleton enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1169-1563-3899-6753.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

628-5256-7211.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Brambleback Brute.
When Brambleback Brute dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

4871-5147-5220-5243.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4871-5147-5220-5243.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

628-3967-7188.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Heirloom Auntie.
When Heirloom Auntie dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

2438-2781-6767.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Rescue Skiff
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

57-2751-3499-4846.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-2751-3499-4846.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2292-3558-4053-6989.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

874-2866-4986-5330.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
874-2866-4986-5330.description:
Cast Delif's Cone by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Delif's Cone by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Delif's Cone from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

147-5147-6475.description:
Cast Reunion of the House by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Reunion of the House.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Reunion of the House, targeting Dualcaster Mage and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Reunion of the House, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2105-3204-4251-4359.notablePrerequisites:
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Godo or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2105-3204-4251-4359.description:
Declare either Godo or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Godo or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Godo or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Godo or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1750-2793-5131-5261-5315.description:
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Ugin's Nexus.
When Ugin's Nexus is sacrificed, it is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Pull from Eternity without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Pull from Eternity, putting Ugin's Nexus from exile into your graveyard.
Cast Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard by paying {5}.
Repeat.

222-527-997-4885.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-997-4885.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Woe Strider twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1651-1887-3715-5365.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one counter on a permanent you control.
1651-1887-3715-5365.description:
Activate Power Conduit by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, putting two +1/+1 counters on Lonis.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Clues, untapping Power Conduit.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

703-1270-1379-2034-2637.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating six token copies of Mechtitan Core that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing two of the Mechtitan Core tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate a Mechtitan Core by paying {5} and exiling it, three other Mechtitan Core tokens, and Astral Dragon, creating three 10/10 Mechtitan legendary creature tokens.
Put all but one of the Mechtitan tokens in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Mechtitan Core triggers twice, returning all cards exiled to create the Mechtitan tokens from exile to the battlefield.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Mechtitan, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Astral Dragon trigger, creating six token copies of Mechtitan Core that are 3/3 Dragons in addition to their other types.
Repeat from step 3.
Once you have infinite {C}, you may forego sacrificing Mechtitan Core tokens to Ashnod's Altar, and then target any other applicable permanents using Astral Dragon.

311-4424-5231.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {U}.
311-4424-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing Coral Trickster, adding {R}.
When Coral Trickster dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Coral Trickster from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Coral Trickster's morph ability by paying {U}, turning it face up.
Coral Trickster triggers, untapping target permanent.
Repeat.

2161-2290-4613.notablePrerequisites: Scion of the Swarm has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2161-2290-4613.description:
Activate Scion of the Swarm using Spike Feeder's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to gain 2 life.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1880-2326-4899.manaNeeded: {3}{G}, plus enough mana to cast the kicker spell kicked
1880-2326-4899.notablePrerequisites: You have a card in hand with kicker or multikicker.
1880-2326-4899.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by paying {0}, exling the top card of your library and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Phyrexian Devourer equal to that card's mana value.
If Phyrexian Devourer's power becomes seven or greater this way, it triggers.
Holding priority, repeat from step 1 until you have an empty library.
With the Phyrexian Devourer triggers on the stack, cast Slippery Bogbonder by paying {3}{G}.
When Slippery Bogbonder enters the battlefield, it triggers, moving all +1/+1 counters from Phyrexian Devourer onto Hallar.
Resolve all Phyrexian Devourer triggers from step 2, causing you to sacrifice it.
Cast any kicker or multikicker spell with kicker by paying its mana cost plus its kicker cost.
Hallar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself, then dealing damage equal to the number of +1/+1 counters on it to each opponent.

2816-3371-4893.notablePrerequisites:
Codie does not have summoning sickness.
Umbral Mantle attached to Codie.
2816-3371-4893.description:
Activate Codie by paying {2} and tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Codie by paying {1} and untapping it, giving it +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.
Once you have an arbitrarily large number of Codie triggers, you may cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost.
Codie triggers for each time you activated its ability.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to exile cards from the top of your library until you exile an instant or sorcery spell with lesser mana value, and allowing you to cast that spell without paying its mana cost.
Repeat step 6 for each remaining trigger.
You may also repeat this combo for each instant and/or sorcery card in your hand, and on subsequent turns.

2393-4050-4516.notablePrerequisites: There have been a number of permanents sacrificed this turn equal to five plus The Balrog's commander tax.
2393-4050-4516.description:
Cast The Balrog from the command zone by paying {B}{R}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The Balrog, adding {B}.
Choose to return The Balrog to the command zone from your graveyard.
When The Balrog dies, it and Sifter of Skulls trigger.
Resolve the Balrog trigger, destroying any artifact and/or creature an opponent controls.
Resolve the Sifter of Skulls trigger, creating a 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Eldrazi Scion, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2232-3783-4605-5157.notablePrerequisites:
You control an additional Illusion creature.
You have a way to cause that Illusion creature to die.
2232-3783-4605-5157.description:
Cause an Illusion you control to die.
Minn triggers, allowing you to put Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar from your hand onto the battlefield.
Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar, Cloudstone Curio, and Preston trigger.
Decline to take any actions for Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar's or Cloudstone Curio's triggers.
Resolve Preston's trigger, creating a 0/1 Illusion token copy of Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar.
Put the token into the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cloudstone Curio and Minn trigger.
Resolve Cloudstone Curio's trigger, returning Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Minn's trigger, putting Asmoranomardicadaistinaculdacar from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

538-1000-2567.manaNeeded: {5}{G}{G}{U}, plus an additional {1} if Mystic Reflection was not foretold
538-1000-2567.description:
Cast Avenger of Zendikar by paying {5}{G}{G}.
Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, triggering its ability and Impact Tremors.
Holding priority, cast Mystic Reflection by paying {1}{U}, causing the next creatures or planeswalkers to enter the battlefield this turn to enter as copies of Avenger of Zendikar.
Resolve the Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a token copy of Avenger of Zendikar for each land you control.
Each Avenger of Zendikar enters the battlefield, triggering their abilities and Impact Tremors that many times.
Resolve an Avenger of Zendikar trigger, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token for each land you control.
The Plants enter the battlefield, triggering Impact Tremors that many times, dealing 1 damage to each opponent for each Plant that entered the battlefield this way.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining trigger.
Resolve all remaining Impact Tremors triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent for each trigger.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Body Launderer

3305-3680-4050-4284.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Stunt Double, adding one mana of any color.
Stunt Double dies, triggering its second ability and Body Launderer's first ability.
Resolve the Stunt Double trigger, returning Clone from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Body Launderer.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Clone, adding one mana of any color.
Clone dies, triggering its second ability and Body Launderer's first ability.
Resolve the Clone trigger, returning Stunt Double from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Body Launderer.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, causing it to connive.
Repeat.

3289-3490-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact.
3289-3490-4659.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing any other artifact you control, adding {C}{C}.
Thraximundar triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

2060-4017-5140.description:
Activate Kenrith's third ability by paying {2}{W}, causing yourself to gain five life.
Crystalline Crawler triggers, putting five +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat.
